phases.summary: Native lifecycle and preview-first installer passed scoped gates. phases.title: CPU/GPU/NPU capability, optimization, and fallback
phases.summary: Completed the Native compute capability assessment: the bounded shared CPU model path and software fallback are documented; stock and experimental graphics results are separated; offline inference remains unverified, GPU inference/NPU remain unavailable, and experimental graphics stay outside release support.

revision_notes.reason: P6 is closed; its previous next_action was the work completed by the P6 completion review and must not remain as an active instruction.

phases.summary: Native workload checks, HOME-scoped name handoff, and the interactive setup guide pass across the supported clients; 719 tests pass. Historical reboot checkpoints and accelerator proof limits remain explicit.
